import json,pathlib,sys,time,unittest
sys.path[:0]=[sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]]
from ai_ad_editor.runtime import configure_local_runtime
configure_local_runtime()
import test_float_raster,test_float_geometry,test_float_pixels,test_float_video_source,test_float_yuv
suite=unittest.TestSuite([unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(module)
    for module in (test_float_raster,test_float_geometry,test_float_pixels,test_float_video_source,test_float_yuv)])
expected=suite.countTestCases();started=time.monotonic()
result=unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
value={'methods':result.testsRun,'discovered_methods':expected,'suite_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,
    'failures':len(result.failures),'errors':len(result.errors),'skipped':len(result.skipped),
    'terminal_success':result.wasSuccessful(),'native_calls':test_float_raster.NATIVE_CALLS+test_float_pixels.NATIVE_CALLS+test_float_video_source.NATIVE_CALLS+test_float_yuv.NATIVE_CALLS}
pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3]).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf8')
raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() and not result.skipped else 1)
